sections: Physical time constants and sampling phase lag

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Multi-Rate Cadences** in *The Nervous System* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, The Nervous System, § Multi-Rate Cadences
blocks.md: A motor drive cannot wait for the next camera-based proposal before regulating winding current. Conversely, forcing a learned policy to evaluate at current-loop rates wastes compute without generating fresher sensory observations. Decoupling these cadences allows each workload to meet its distinct physical or computational deadline, provided the boundary interface preserves data freshness and never blocks local real-time control.

questions.q: The section **Multi-Rate Cadences** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A safety microcontroller claims lockstep cores, ECC, memory protection, clock and supply monitors, self-test, and an external windowed watchdog, far more than physical separation on a board.

An admitted chunk may drive the actuators only for a lease counted on the permission path's own clock, derived from the plant: longer than the renewal period plus jitter and short enough to fit under the pre-brake ceiling of the stopping budget.
Whether every axis exchanges command and feedback within the bus cycle is a necessary check computed from frame geometry, but occupancy alone is not a response bound.

Proposals cross rate boundaries as state messages, not events, so a single-slot seqlock or wait-free multi-slot mailbox gives the faster reader one bounded, nonblocking attempt per tick that returns a complete snapshot or keeps the previous one.
